mentions.name: LLMatcher
mentions.description: A blind testing arena for finding which AI model actually works best for a given user. Users enter prompts, compare two anonymous model responses, and pick the better one; after voting, the app reveals which models were preferred. It was built because model benchmarks don't match real-world preference, and blind pairwise comparison cuts through the hype.
mentions.problem: Model benchmarks don't match real-world preference, so users need blind pairwise comparison to cut through the hype.
mentions.source_excerpt:
